channel.title: Lie Detector: Truth or Deception
channel.desc: Years after beloved actor Gary Coleman's controversial and tragic death, his ex-wife, Shannon Price, agrees to take a polygraph test to confront lingering suspicions and silence the rumors that she was responsible for his death. Did she play any role in Gary's untimely demise-or has she been unfairly judged by public opinion? The truth is put to the test in an emotional and revealing examination.
